 While Richard Lloyd’s (who passed away on 11/7/26) distinctive guitar work is best remembered for his stellar leads with Television, his solo career remains largely overlooked, especially his 1985 album Field of Fire . In this 1986 live clip, Lloyd moves well beyond the familiar boundaries of punk and hard rock, carving out a sound that is entirely his own. His playing is angular, volatile and unpredictable, building tension through sustained notes, jagged runs and sudden bursts of distortion. Always years ahead of his time, Lloyd might well be receiving the same critical attention as Geese and Parquet Courts.
